name: Four Admissible Signs in the Remote Clause Tower
definition: Fix every signed minimal-nonface clause of the remote rooted tower except the clause on old coordinates $(5,6,9,10)$. At level zero the common ample completion is $R_0=B_0\cup\{604\}$ and the common outside slice is $A_0=\{28\}$; paired-square transfer gives $A_j=A_0\times\{01,11,10\}^j$.
parameters: At level $j\ge0$, the outside family has $3^j$ concepts and the common completion has $(583\cdot3^j-3)/2$ concepts.
properties: Exactly four omitted traces are admissible: $0110,1001,0101,1101$, deleting respectively the base-completion vertices $604,1084,1116,1148$. The first class fails to peel to zero and the other three peel to zero. The same four signs exhaust both ordinary forbidden-pivot stages; exactly the first is a forbidden pc-minor, all proper minors of all four peel, and all four square-completed classes are two-connected.
